newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nihon Kogyo, Sekisui Jushi in equity tieup.
newsitem.headline: Nihon Kogyo, Sekisui Jushi in equity tieup.

text.p: Concrete producer Nihon Kogyo Co Ltd said on Monday that it and resin processor Sekisui Jushi Corp had agreed on an equity tie-up and to cooperate in business.
The tie-up is expected to increase Nihon Kogyo's sales by 300 million yen in the year to March 31, 1998, Nihon Kogyo said in a statement.
Under the agreement, Sekisui Jushi will buy 3.1 million new shares of Nihon Kogyo at 475 yen per share through a third-party allocation, Nihon Kogyo said.

Sekisui Jushi will own a 20.23 percent stake in Nihon Kogyo after the share issue, it said. Sekisui Jushi does not currently own shares in Nihon Kogyo, it said. Nihon Kogyo did not provide details of the business alliance.
Nihon Kogyo will also buy shares of Sekisui Jushi, it said.
The shares will be worth 20 percent of the total value of Sekisui Jushi's purchase of Nihon Kogyo, it said.
